mentions.note: Life Member, Vice President and one time Cross Country Captain; died 1956
18th in 1913 and 13th in 1915 South of Thames Junior races; gave the Musselbrook Cup for the Junior 1500m

photos.c: The photograph opposite was taken outside Tom Sullivan's club room on the day of the Club '7' of 1912.
PHOTOGRAPH OPPOSITE---1913 South of Thames "Junior" winners. Left to Right:- Dick Best (17th), Joe Helm (9th), Harry Parker (15th), Ernie Musselbrook (18th) and Oscar Horwood (16th).
